title: The Persuasion Knowledge Model: How People Cope with Persuasion Attempts

verification.verification_notes: Bibliographic metadata (authors, container, 21(1):1-31, DOI) confirmed via Crossref on 2026-09-24; full text not inspected. The Persuasion Knowledge Model holds that people develop and apply knowledge about persuasion attempts, monitoring messages and message agents for persuasive intent, and coping with a repertoire that can include resistance as well as compliance. Used here for the reader-side analogue of the cynical stance: audiences already monitor stated motives. No passage quoted.
